:::{#exr-log-partition-normalization}
#### The exponential of the log-partition function is a normalizing integral

Let $\Rvar$ be a continuous random variable
whose [density](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pdf) has the form of @eq-exponential-family.
Use the fact that a density integrates to one
to show that

$$
\expf{\logpartitionf{\natparam}}
= \int \basemeasuref{\rvar} \, \expf{\natparam \, \statf{\rvar}} \, d\rvar.
$$

For a discrete random variable, replace the integral with a sum over the possible values.

:::
